title: Strike a match
kid_text: A grown-up strikes the match away from you.
safety: The flame can reach your fingers. Shake it out first.

steps.text: Close the box before you strike.
Strike the strip away from your body.
Tilt the match head down so it catches.
Shake it out before the flame hits your fingers.
Touch the flame to the fluffy nest.

mistakes.fix: Turn your back to the wind.

mistakes.text: The flame runs to your fingers.
mistakes.fix: Shake it out and drop it.
